correctness.rationale: The zero-sum subspace on the unmarked clique vertices has eigenvalue −1. The complementary block in the hub, normalized unmarked sum, leaf basis has characteristic cubic x^3−(m−2)x^2−mx+(m−2). For m≥3 the sign-change intervals (−2,−1), (0,1), and (m−1,m) are disjoint and exhaust the roots. On bounded x the leading rescaled polynomial is −(x^2+x−1); both bounded roots are within O(1/m) of its simple zeros. Independently, an eigenvector with hub coordinate 1 has unmarked-sum coordinate sqrt(m−1)/(λ−m+2) and leaf coordinate 1/λ. Its normalized hub mass is the reciprocal of 1+(m−1)/(λ−m+2)^2+λ^(-2), giving (1±1/sqrt(5))/2+O(1/m) with the larger mass on the negative root. The remaining mass is O(1/m). The marked return modulus is bounded below for every real time by twice its largest mass minus one, whereas the bare clique return lies in [1−2/m,1]. At the fixed time π/sqrt(5) the limiting bounded modes oppose each other, proving a matching lower bound with O(1/m) error; the rapidly varying mode contributes only its small mass. For two unmarked vertices the dark −1 term cancels except for the difference of normalization weights, giving a complex-amplitude bound 1/(m−1)+1/m+1/[m(m−1)]=2/(m−1). A mixed hub/unmarked entry is bounded in difference by 1/sqrt(m−1)+2/m. These two bounds are eventually smaller than the marked fixed-time discrepancy, so the slower mixed-entry rate does not spoil the O(1/m) error of the supremum.
residual_risks: The fixed time is an asymptotic witness, not a claimed optimizer at finite m; probabilities, Laplacians, and normalized adjacency are not covered.

originality.rationale: The distinct contribution is a sharp nonvanishing uniform-in-time modulus discrepancy from attaching one leaf at one marked clique vertex, with localization and a fixed-time witness. The strongest inspected prior theorem controls regular joins and explicitly leaves the merely induced case open. The closest cataloged pendant-graph results concern corona constructions and average mixing, not this perturbation and observable.
residual_risks: A marked-vertex spectral or walk computation for this graph under other terminology such as kite, lollipop, or pineapple could overlap; the bounded primary and catalog comparisons do not determine absolute priority.

value.rationale: A single external edge already defeats a vanishing uniform-in-time modulus bound depending only on the size of a complete induced core, in a form directly responsive to the published join-versus-induced question. The constant, exceptional location, and fixed observation time distinguish persistent local dynamics from errors that require observation times diverging with graph size or affect the whole core.
residual_risks: The obstruction is specific and does not classify which other attachments preserve induced-core dynamics.
